text: British American Tobacco is a publicly listed company; its shares have a primary listing on the London Stock Exchange and it is a FTSE 100 constituent.
short: BAT is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is in the FTSE 100.

source.name: Wikipedia – British American Tobacco
